name: The Testament: The Secret of Anita Harley
original_name: O Testamento: O Segredo de Anita Harley
overview: Anita Harley is the main shareholder of Casas Pernambucanas, one of the most traditional retail chains in the country. This series brings the behind-the-scenes disputes surrounding her inheritance in one of the most complex and intriguing cases in the Brazilian judiciary.
